subject: general
question: When was the Smart Cities Mission launched by the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __2015__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, G**overnment of India launched the Smart Cities Mission on 25 June 2015.**
 
• The objective of the program is to promote sustainable and inclusive cities that provide core infrastructure and give a decent quality of life to their citizens, a **clean and sustainable environment, and the application of ‘Smart’ Solutions.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

The core infrastructure elements in a smart city include:

 
• Sufficient water supply
 
• Guaranteed electricity supply
 
• Sanitation with proper solid waste management
 
• Systematic urban mobility and structured public transport
 
• Low-cost housing, especially for the poor
 
• Strong and vigorous IT connectivity and digitalization
 
• good governance, especially e-Governance and enhanced citizen participation
 
• sustainable environment
 
• proper safety and security of citizens, especially women, children and the elderly
 
• affordable health and education for all.

 
• This is not, the final list. Each city is free to add more applications as per their requirement.
 
• The selection process for Smart Cities is based on the idea of Competitive and Co-operative Federalism. 
 
• It follows an All India competition to select cities.
